name: Anthridercynantide
source:
A street worker gathers all his savings to go abroad and face a woman who he believes shares a common past with him.

[From the [url=http://atpprojects.mygamesonline.org/visualnovels.htm]Official site[/url]]
translation:
一名街头工作者拿出全部积蓄前往异国，与一个他认定和自己拥有共同过去的女人当面对质。

[译自 [url=http://atpprojects.mygamesonline.org/visualnovels.htm]官方网站[/url]]
